info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Loan Application By Decision Id-spec
info.description: The Loan Application Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information regarding specific loan applications based on their associated decision IDs. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of loan application data, enabling financial service providers, underwriters, and customer support teams to review application decisions efficiently. Typical use cases include checking the status of loan applications or providing updates to applicants. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can streamline the loan review process and improve customer service interactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the decision details for a specific loan application identified by its unique ID. Utilize this to get insights into the approval or denial of the application, as well as any relevant parameters guiding the decision.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching the decision associated with the specified loan application. This body structure facilitates the retrieval of decision details by identifying the loan application through its unique identifier.

200.description: Success: The request was processed and the decision data is returned.

GetLoanApplicationByDecisionIdRequest.description: Request body schema for the loan application decision GET operation, expected in JSON format.

decision.description: The decision made on the loan application (e.g., approved, denied).

decisionSource.description: The source of the decision (e.g., automated system, manual review).

provisional.description: Indicates whether the decision is provisional.

creditScore.description: The credit score of the applicant.

riskGrade.description: The risk grade assigned to the applicant.

probabilityOfDefaultPercent.description: The probability of default percentage based on the assessment.

debtToIncomePercent.description: The debt-to-income ratio percentage of the applicant.

approvedPrincipal.description: Details of the approved principal amount.

approvedTermMonths.description: The term of the loan in months.

approvedAnnualInterestRatePercent.description: The annual interest rate as a percentage for the loan.

conditions.description: A list of conditions attached to the decision.

audit.description: Audit details associated with the decision.

metadata.description: Metadata details associated with the request.
